Signature verification detects any in-transit tampering of the token payload

implementations.evidence: The session token uses asymmetric cryptography (RSA PKCS1v15 + SHA-256) to sign the token payload, protecting the integrity of inter-component communications in transit. A tampered token will fail signature verification.

Launches Caddy with Caddyfile config enabling TLS/mTLS reverse proxy

Uvicorn started with ssl_certfile/ssl_keyfile if env vars present

code_blocks.summary: TestHTTPRejection: verifies all servers accept HTTPS and reject HTTP (403/426)
TestHTTPRedirect: verifies HTTP:80 redirects to HTTPS or returns 426

TestNoHTTPInCode: asserts zero http://localhost refs in production source

implementations.evidence: The test suite (SEC-HTTPS-001) verifies that all REST services reject plain HTTP with 403/426, that HTTP redirects to HTTPS (301), that mTLS is enforced on internal services (EvaluateCare :8081, SharedServices :8082), and that no http:// URLs appear in production code — collectively verifying that all communications use HTTPS/TLS for confidentiality and integrity in transit.

SSL certfile/keyfile applied to uvicorn for encrypted transport

implementations.evidence: PEM certificates are bootstrapped from environment secrets, TLS cert/key are applied to uvicorn, and mTLS is referenced for production inter-service communication, implementing transmission confidentiality and integrity protection.
